messages.subject: FINAL independent review: no blocking findings remain (SOFTWARE_ONLY)
messages.body: Verdict: ACCEPT for software integration; launch evidence remains NOT_RUN. Evidence checked by me: final tree pytest receipt 964 passed/2 skipped (validation/pytest.txt), my local FUSE+transfer runs (130 and 49 passed), transfer smoke SOFTWARE_ONLY with gpu/real NOT_RUN and one COMMITTED synthetic TEST, CPU_PREFLIGHT code SHAs equal local tree. Contract recheck: v3 config pins source SHA bf2de828/meta 5c2791fb/identity (match committed full-label sidecar); strict whole-model load after SHA+SELECTED+identity; T_tgt T-b only, 16 L frames x250 epochs batch2 = 2000 steps/4000 exposures, VAL per L8 epoch; J 175x100=17500; zero-shot frozen before T, report-only, excluded from choose_deployment; one TEST ledger with 4 labels and pre-ledger artifact/config/source-container verification; v1/v2 keep 3 labels and their resume semantics; non-L8 TRAIN masks unreachable; TEST member_sha256 null bound by archive SHA/name/size/CRC, no TEST payload during preparation. Blocking findings found and FIXED/rechecked: (1) zero-shot source metadata vs evaluate_exports; (2) campaign export_bundle mode alias; (3) epoch-boundary T checkpoint skipping VAL on resume; (4) v1 partial-budget resume duplicate VAL (W2 regression); (5) profile _autocast arity + evaluate_modes NameError + v3-only profile; (6) TEST archive SHA only inside ledger; (7) cache env missing; (8) queue lacking real data preflight; (9) Drive duplicate names / DELETE_FAILED (coordinator found real pathless geometry + float mask; rechecked OK). Non-blocking LOW remaining: v1/v2 profile is a reimplementation not original; profile B T loss own slicing/no augmentation, weights_only=False after SHA; adapted teacher.pt.meta provenance lists only nnFoundation build (real B still needs Q3D_NNFOUNDATION_WEIGHTS present though overwritten); no explicit post-T assert steps==2000; AppleDouble ._*.py on server checkout appear in code receipt; monitor waits unbounded (wait, not retry). Cleanup: guards adequate given single uninterrupted producer stream (your attestation; I read the producer). Not reviewed: server state, clean-copy staged run (still running), real GPU behavior.

messages.subject: Track B independent review complete: ACCEPT (SOFTWARE_ONLY), no blocking findings remain
messages.body: I did a read-only review of the Track B diff against aec26cf plus the new files, including the engine/config/teacher/evaluation code, data/builder, campaign/profile/queue, archive_cleanup.py and server_monitor.py, and rechecked every fix in this same session using scratch repro scripts and local test runs (130 FUSE tests and 49 transfer/data tests passed; the coordinator's final full suite shows 964 passed). I found 9 blocking defects and all are now fixed and rechecked: the zero-shot provenance mismatch, the campaign mode alias, the epoch-boundary resume that skipped VAL, a v1 resume regression, the profile autocast arity and NameError plus loss of v1/v2 profiling, a TEST archive SHA checked only inside the ledger, the missing cache env, the queue's missing data preflight, and duplicate Drive names. Only LOW items are left (v1/v2 profile is a reimplementation, profile loss parity and weights_only, adapted-teacher provenance, no explicit 2000-step assertion, AppleDouble files on the server, unbounded monitor waits); the clean-copy staged test run, server state and real GPU/patient evidence were not reviewed and remain NOT_RUN.
